summary_en: Fuji United Holdings executed a fixed-price ToSTNeT-3 purchase of 190,000 shares (2.9% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) at 1,234 yen per share on November 9, 2026, totaling approximately 234.5 million yen. The purchase is the first tranche of a broader buyback authorization approved on the same date for up to 342,000 shares (5.2% of outstanding) for up to 500 million yen through November 2027, to be followed by open market purchases.
title_en: Notice Regarding the Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Exchange Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 6, 2026, the board of Fuji United Holdings resolved to acquire up to 342,000 treasury shares (5.2% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for up to 500 million yen through March 31, 2027, via open market purchase and ToSTNeT-3 off-exchange trading. The company stated the purpose is to implement flexible capital policy in response to the operating environment.

On the same day, the company executed the first tranche through ToSTNeT-3 at the closing price of 1,234 yen per share. The fixed-price transaction acquired 190,000 shares (2.9% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for approximately 234.46 million yen, settling on November 9, 2026. The purchase order was placed at 8:45 a.m. for execution in the ToSTNeT-3 auction.

Following this ToSTNeT-3 execution, the company will continue acquiring shares under the broader buyback program through open market purchases using the remaining authorization of up to 152,000 shares and approximately 265.54 million yen through the end of March 2027.
